items.title: Define a command-local evidence hash snapshot contract
items.context: Add or expose a narrow primitive that captures HEAD/materialHash/storyFilesHash with enough git-state context to prevent stale reuse. It must be host-neutral and must not be a persistent cache.

happy.desc: captureEvidenceHashSnapshot returns one coherent headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash binding for the same git cwd and metadata root

edge.desc: the snapshot records material dirty state so dirty material worktree changes cannot be silently reused

adversarial.desc: the contract exposes no persistent cache and no mtime or file-count based freshness shortcut

items.userSees: User sees "captureEvidenceHashSnapshot: reusable=true, materialDirty=false" in the focused smoke output.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke printed captureEvidenceHashSnapshot: reusable=true, materialDirty=false and asserted one headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash binding for the same git cwd and metadata root.
Smoke asserted clean snapshots have no material dirt and that dirty material worktree drift makes the old snapshot unsafe.
Build passed with an in-memory EvidenceHashSnapshot contract; implementation adds no persistent cache and no mtime/file-count proof shortcut.

items.title: Thread the snapshot through DONE and review assurance consumers
items.context: Consumers that already operate within one command/gate run should reuse the same captured binding instead of recomputing currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash independently, while retaining stale checks at gate boundaries.

happy.desc: DONE oracle/review escalation/review assurance paths reuse a supplied command-local material/story binding instead of recomputing independently

edge.desc: if no reusable binding is supplied, consumers retain existing recomputation and stale-check behavior

adversarial.desc: a stale supplied binding is not accepted after HEAD or material dirty state changes

items.userSees: User sees "DONE currentBinding reused: materialHash=<hash> storyFilesHash=<hash>" in the focused smoke output.

verificationEvidence.note: Freshness smoke now pairs the existing runtime reuse check with static production call-site assertions proving runDoneOracleGate, buildStoryReadinessReport/buildDoneRows, and session_brief DONE pre-check capture and pass evidenceHashSnapshot.
Review-escalation freshness-root smoke passed after threading snapshots, confirming fallback/recomputation behavior remains valid where no supplied snapshot is available.
Freshness smoke rejected a stale supplied snapshot after dirty material drift, and delivery-check freshness smoke still proves story-owned drift remains stale across DONE consumers.

items.title: Prove reuse does not admit stale evidence
items.context: Add focused regression coverage for unchanged-state reuse and changed-state invalidation: HEAD drift, dirty worktree/index drift, and story-owned file drift must all force a fresh binding or fail stale checks.

happy.desc: focused smoke coverage proves unchanged-state snapshot reuse passes

edge.desc: focused smoke coverage proves story-owned file drift changes storyFilesHash and blocks stale evidence

adversarial.desc: focused smoke coverage proves dirty material worktree state prevents unsafe snapshot reuse

items.userSees: User sees "stale supplied snapshot rejected after dirty material drift" in the focused smoke output.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke asserted unchanged-state snapshot reuse succeeds and printed captureEvidenceHashSnapshot: reusable=true, materialDirty=false.
Delivery-check freshness smoke passed its story-owned change after delivery-check is stale across DONE consumers case.
Focused smoke printed stale supplied snapshot rejected after dirty material drift and asserted reusable=false/materialDirty=true.

items.title: Document the syndrome-preflight boundary
items.context: Record why this is a safe Proofbound optimization: exact hash-bound evidence remains authoritative, no mtime cache, no erasure-code recovery, and no global cache semantics.

happy.desc: proof-admissibility docs describe the command-local syndrome-preflight boundary

edge.desc: docs explicitly say mtime/file-count keys and persistent caches are non-goals

adversarial.desc: docs explicitly reject fountain-code or erasure-code recovery as evidence semantics

items.userSees: User sees "syndrome preflight is command-local only; no persistent cache" in the documentation check output.

verificationEvidence.note: Doc grep found the new M1 command-local syndrome preflight subsection.
Doc grep found the subsection line saying no persistent cache and no mtime or file-count freshness keys.
Doc grep found the explicit fountain/erasure-code evidence recovery non-goal.

auditLog.reason: Reopen for B-8963:F-001: production DONE/session/lifecycle call sites must supply the command-local snapshot, not only tests.
